verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state you can "run larger models on Ollama's Cloud without the download" [ollama-docs-8]. They also say cloud models can be called with an API key and no local installation [ollama-docs-20], and that tools can be launched against local or cloud models [ollama-docs-15]. Base URLs for both local and cloud are documented [ollama-docs-9], and dedicated capacity is advertised [ollama-docs-4]. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of which large models are offered and of cloud tier limits, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that cloud offload works as described.
